''See also: [[Suu Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Suu is a versatile weapon inherited by [[Mercy]] from her mother, who was a [[Monarch]]. The object is primarily used as a bow, though it can also take the form of a staff or walking stick. In its bow configuration, it is described as being taller than [[Mercy]] and constructed from smooth black strands that resemble knotted vines. A dragon's head, featuring violet eyes, is positioned at the center of the shaft, serving as the point from which arrows emerge. The weapon possesses a significant amount of aura and can function as a staff that [[Mercy]] uses for support or movement. It is also noted that the bow contains the will of a [[Sage]]'s [[Remnant]], which allows its arrows to actively seek targets. While [[Mercy]] also refers to the weapon as [[Eclipse]], an [[Ancient Bow of the Soulseeker]], she uses the name Suu to address it personally.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|This entity is woven from slick black strands and features the head of a violet-eyed dragon at the center of its shaft. It can manifest as a walking stick or a staff made of twisted [[black madra]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Suu can transform between the forms of a staff and a bow. In its bow form, it is capable of firing violet arrows.}}
